question: Does the frozen Freebase canonical (302M nodes) have questions, and can WebQSP questions be mapped onto its positions?
answer: Freebase carries no queries (DATASET.json n_queries = 0). The NSM sibling release keys WebQSP questions/answers by Freebase MID; uid = hash(mid utf-8) under PYTHONHASHSEED=0 -> searchsorted(node_uid) resolves them. The legacy bridge/webqsp_positions.npy cannot (gold answers there are name-only RoG nodes, 0/5,606 resolve).
reads: NSM dev_simple + train_simple lines whose id is in the 786-row development population only; no TEST file, no split-B id; counts only, nothing written to a served artifact
caveats: NSM answer sets differ from the RoG gold-node sets of the 786 rows (8,263 NSM answer MIDs vs 5,606 RoG gold nodes): the retrieval target would be defined by the NSM answers
26/31 unresolved dev answers are MIDs absent from the cleaned freebase_v3; 5 are literal values (dates)
retrieval on Freebase needs the 245M-row dense encode (not complete) or a name-sharded surrogate; this record is a mapping check only
